required.note: Missing any of the three (mention, hashtag, bio link) means no payout. The bio link is account-level, not per post.

duration.note: Comedy needs its setup. Shorter than 20s usually drops the premise; past 45s the punchline is too far from the hook.

hook.note: Same calibration as before: open on the line that works as a caption by itself.

caption_rules.note: Captions are the spoken words only. Nothing invented, no editorialising, no claim the guest did not make.

rules: A banned moment invalidates every candidate window that overlaps it - cut around it or pick another moment.
Slurs and Nazi/Hitler references must never appear in titles, captions or on-screen text, even if the speech is cut.
Bleeped slurs are banned and invisible to a transcript-based guard: review by ear.

rejection_reasons: content from the DO NOT CLIP list

picture.note: Frozen is measured as a held picture (frames that are the same image) over the footage area, not as whole-frame change: a podcast close-up scores 2.5 on whole-frame change while the mouth is clearly moving.

grade.note: Footage only; plates, end card and caption ink stay exact.

captions.note: The brief requires verbatim captions, so a spoken 'like' or 'you know' cannot be removed without misquoting the speaker. The count is reported on every gate run as a quality signal instead of failing the render. Nothing else about the caption rules is relaxed.

_note_required_features: Every finished post must carry all of these. skill_gate.py reads this list and fails a render that skipped one - the first version of this campaign's renderer shipped without the motion layer and nothing noticed.
